title: Measure with a camera · level 1
brief: The robot stands still with G10.2's camera (Camera Module 3, 640 x 480, 66 degrees; forward 60, left 0, height 120, tilt down 30). Five 30 mm discs (blue, green, red, yellow, black) lie at seeded places 220-800 mm ahead of the axle. Make the frame folder, run your PC program on it, and write each disc's floor position (x forward, y left, mm, from the axle's middle) to report.json; Score report scores it. A run scores 100 x clamp(1 - e / 40 mm, 0, 1), e the mean error over the five discs (the pairing with the least total distance; a disc not written counts 40 mm; more than five points score 0).

score.summary: round(sum(r in runs: r.points) / count(r in runs: true), 1)

pass: score >= 60 & count(r in runs: r.reportCount == 5) >= 0.8 * n

sources.where: G10.2 Robot (the class robot plus Camera Module 3, forward 60, left 0, height 120, tilt down 30; the challenge fixes the robot) and Challenge - Measure with a camera: level 1, the run's score 100 x clip(1 - e / 40 mm, 0, 1), N = 10, the default pass (mean at least 60, at least 80 % of runs with all five written)
